parameters.name: EndpointId
parameters.description: The ID of the endpoint to query.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Valid values: **1** to **50**. Default value: **50**.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description:
Specifies whether there is a next query token. Valid values:
- Leave this parameter empty for the first query or when no next query exists.
- If a next query exists, set this parameter to the **NextToken** value returned by the previous API call.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the endpoint to query.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~120468~~) operation to obtain the region ID.
